'''Feasibility''' was a subdivision of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Production Division]]. It analyzed the data gathered by [[Scout Services]] and suggested potential uses for [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
